description: List sales and refund receipts, newest first, with line items, payments, discounts and taxes. Filter by store, time range or receipt numbers — the core of any sales question. Loyverse: GET /receipts.

before_receipt_number.description: Only receipts created up to the receipt with this number.

created_at_max.description: Only records created at or before this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

created_at_min.description: Only records created at or after this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

cursor.description: The `cursor` from the previous page's response. Omit for the first page.

order.description: Only receipts with this order name/number.

receipt_numbers.description: Comma-separated receipt numbers to return, e.g. 2-1008,2-1009.

since_receipt_number.description: Only receipts created at or after the receipt with this number.

source.description: Only receipts from this source (e.g. an app name).

updated_at_max.description: Only records updated at or before this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

updated_at_min.description: Only records updated at or after this time (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-03-30T18:30:00.000Z).

name: loyverse_list_receipts
title: List receipts
